article_content: Los Angeles (CNN) -- On Friday, Lindsay Lohan was taken into custody after Judge Stephanie Sautner sentenced her to 120 days in jail for violating her drunk driving probation in a necklace theft case. She was expected to post a 75,000-dollar bond and be released. Furthermore, the judge ordered Lohan to serve 480 hours of community service, with 360 of those hours at a women's center in downtown Los Angeles. Judge Sautner noted that the experience might help Lohan understand the hardships encountered by truly needy women. The judge also ruled that the necklace theft case would go forward to trial, though the felony charge was reduced to a misdemeanor. Sautner suggested that if it was accidental, Lohan could have contacted the store immediately. Defense attorney Shawn Holley argued that Lohan walked out with the necklace by mistake due to being busy and unfocused, while Prosecutor Danette Meyers insisted she only returned it because police had obtained a search warrant. Store owner Sofia Kamen testified she received no funds from licensing the security footage, saying that any earnings went to a publicist she later fired. A store employee recalled another incident in which Lohan nearly left wearing a diamond earring before being stopped. Lohan's trial date was set for June 3, with a mandatory hearing on May 11. Even with the misdemeanor charge, she could face up to a year in prison. Before reducing the charge, Judge Sautner referenced Lohan's past courtroom behavior. Lohan has appeared frequently over the past year, mostly due to probation issues resulting from her 2007 drunk driving case, and she served a short jail sentence last year before undergoing mandated rehab twice.
translated_content: Los Angeles (CNN) -- Dina Jumat, Lindsay Lohan kasirep ring tahanan sapunika sasampun Hakim Stephanie Sautner nangkepang 120 rahina panglateyon ring bui, krana ida ngelanggar probasi maboya majalan kasus maling kalung. Ia kapinat ngijinin 75.000 dolar dadi jaminan tur kasub prasida keluar uli tahanan. Saleran punika, sang hakim nganihin Lohan ngayahin 480 jam lingkungan sosial, ring antuk 360 jam ring pusat wanita ring puseh kutha Los Angeles. Hakim Sautner ngaraos yening pengalaman punika dados kawigunan, mangda Lohan mangerti keangon sengsara wanita sane kantun kepatihang. Sang hakim medalang kasus maling kalung punika ngranjing ring pangadilan, nanging dakwaan feloni kaedengin dados dakwaan pelanggaran ringan. Hakim Sautner ngaraos yen nasional punika dadi kecelakaan, mestinya Lohan nyurati toko punika jemet. Pengacara Shawn Holley nandasang yening Lohan tegep ngidih tur kesusu, sedeng Jaksa Danette Meyers nandesang Lohan namakin kalung punika lantaran sampun mawali ring polisi masa suba dados warran nyaring. Pamilik toko, Sofia Kamen, megancan nenten nyaman ragadang artha saking lisensi video keamanan, ngaraos yening artha punika baine makejang ring publisis sane suba ia pegat. Sorang pegawai toko nyandika kejadian Lohan maobuh ka luar toko masih maanggon anting permata, sadurung ia tortedeng. Sidang Lohan kapastikang ring 3 Juni, tur ida musti plong ring pengadilan tanggal 11 Mei. Sanadyan kaorahang dados dakwaan ringan, setahun ring bui tetap patut cameka. Satungtung nyobeang ring ring kesayutan dakwaan, Hakim Sautner mautsaha ring prilaku Lohan di pengadilan sane kaimbuhin media. Ia sampun ping kesekian rauh ring pengadilan nangi ngelanggar probasi maboya 2007, tur sempat kakutang wakti sedek tiosan pendak rehab kaping dua.

article_content: 'An inquest heard that 34-year-old mother-of-three, Ms Swanson, died after gallstone removal operations were cancelled twice due to head lice and a high heart rate.' 'She was first diagnosed with acute pancreatitis, triggered by gallstones, in October 2012 at Leicester General Hospital. This placed her among the worst-affected 20 per cent of patients, half of whom do not survive.' 'Ms Swanson was initially kept in hospital for a week and discharged with the plan for surgery within six weeks. However, it was not until February 2013, when her weight had fallen from 20st 13lbs to 12st 2lbs, that she returned for a pre-operative assessment.' 'At that time, the operation was postponed because of her head lice and high heart rate, and was cancelled again a month later. On April 1, she went to A&E at the Leicester Royal Infirmary with severe pain and was transferred to Leicester General Hospital shortly after.' 'She died on June 6, having spent a month in a high dependency unit. Her partner, Mr Lee Dunning, said Ms Swanson was very upset by the cancellations, but hospital staff defended their decision, citing potential infection concerns due to scalp irritation caused by lice.' 'Dr Clare Brown, a senior surgeon, explained that microscopic cuts from scratching could lead to infections. Consultant surgeon Matthew Metcalf noted that Ms Swanson was in a high-risk category for pancreatitis, stating that surgery would not have saved her life.' 'The inquest continues, with a conclusion expected soon. The hospital maintains it followed the correct procedure, emphasizing limited treatment options for severe pancreatitis.'
translated_content: 'Ring inquest, ibu tigang anak umur 34, Ibu Swanson, kapinget mati sasampun operasi nyoplos batu empedu kakandidin pindua akibat kutu buron lan jantung sane ngalih tinggi.' 'Ia kapolih diagnosis pancreatitis akut karena batu empedu rikala Oktober 2012 ring Leicester General Hospital, lan kondisi punika nyubengang ia dadi bagian ring 20 persen pasien sane paling gaduh risiko, saning 50 persenna mati.' 'Ibu Swanson sampun nginep ring rumah sakit saluik seminggu tur kasenengin ngajak mendak operasi saluik 6 minggu. Nanging, nebang Februari 2013, bareng bobotne lungsur saking 20st 13lbs dadi 12st 2lbs, ia ngalih ka pre-operative assessment.' 'Wenten rika, operasine kepending sebab kutu buron lan jantung sane cepet, tur kapending malih saje gegancangan wulan. Ring tanggal 1 April, ia ngaba ka A&E ring Leicester Royal Infirmary karna nyeri keras, sasampun nika ia kapindah ka Leicester General Hospital.' 'Ia mati ring 6 Juni, sasampun sebulan ring unit high dependency. Pasanganne, Bapak Lee Dunning, ngarsitayang yen Ibu Swanson sangat sedih mireng pembatalan punika, nanging staf rumah sakit nganggep punika sampun bener, mangda ngicenin resiko infeksi lantaran garukan ring kulit sirah.' 'Dr Clare Brown, surgeon senior, nerangin yen guritan alit saking garukan dados sumber infeksi. Konsultan surgeon Matthew Metcalf nyebatang yen Ibu Swanson kelampahan ring kategori risiko sampun ageng sangkaning pancreatitis, mapastikan operasi tusing dadi upaya nyalametang nyawanne.' 'Inquest puniki masih lumaku, mahananing kasimpulan pungkasan. Rumah sakit ngutiang sampun nglakonin tata cara sane bener, mekejang tawaran perawatan kaanggep winates ring pancreatitis sane abot.'

article_content: European autumn breaks are now even better value for Britons as the pound strengthens against the euro. After a dip in sterling, attributed to uncertainty around the Scottish referendum, the pound has climbed again. With the euro at about 1.28 to the pound, Britons enjoy around eight percent more spending power than this time last year. British tourists can benefit from the pound's resurgence in popular destinations like Paris. Foreign currency firm Travelex revealed that, on Friday, Britons exchanging £500 can now receive approximately £36 more than twelve months ago. 'We saw consistent growth of the pound in early 2014, which was unsettled by referendum worries,' said David Swann of Travelex. 'It is reassuring to see the pound back on track, helped by the Bank of England leaning toward higher interest rates,' he added. Travelex states that Britons stand to receive more value when converting pounds to euros compared to last year.
translated_content: Liburan musim gugur ring Eropa jani dados langkung mirah bagi turis Britania, karna paund malih mekeran ngalawan euro. Sampun wenten penurunan ring sterling sangkaning keragu-raguan referendum Skotlandia, tapi paund sampun naik malih. Kalawan kurs euro kirang langkung 1,28 per paund, turis Britania ngraosang kira-kira 8% langkung kekuatan belanja malih sekadi warsa sidosan. Turis Britania dados leuwih untung antuk penguatan paund puniki ring tujuan wisata favorit, makadi Paris. Perusahaan mata uang asing Travelex maos ring Sukra, turis Britania sane ngganti £500 dados euro jani anggon kabet tambahan kira-kira £36 malih dibanding setahun sidosan. 'Kami ningalin peningkatan konsisten paund ring awal 2014, ananging sampun keganggu sangkaning referendum,' ngaraos David Swann saking Travelex. 'Nyen tenang ningalin paund dados kuat malih, dibantu antuk Bank of England sane nyiapang munggah bunga selanjutnya,' tambah ipun. Travelex nangih turis Britania sida nincapang ento langkung besar tur panguntung ring ngeganti paund dados euro dibanding warsa sidosan.

article_content: Samuel Sanchez finally claimed his first Tour de France stage victory on Thursday, while fellow Spanish cyclist Alberto Contador suffered a setback to his title hopes as the race entered the mountains. Sanchez, fourth in last year's Tour, began the 12th stage from Cugnaux to Luz Ardiden more than five minutes behind leader Thomas Voeckler. However, the 2008 Olympic road race champion surged ahead of fellow breakaway riders on the final climb alongside Jelle Vanendert. The 33-year-old edged the Belgian by seven seconds, earning a memorable triumph in the Pyrenees. It came nearly a decade after his Euskaltel team's first Tour stage win at Luz Ardiden. Commenting on his tactics, Sanchez said, 'I knew it was an important day, and I had to try something since my position in the general classification wasn't threatening to others. I had my chance, and I went for it. I also noticed that Andy Schleck and Alberto Contador had lost key teammates, so our escape wasn't reeled in.' Sanchez finished 50 seconds ahead of Voeckler, who stayed in the yellow jersey by placing ninth. Contador, the defending champion chasing a fourth title, ended eighth. He now stands four minutes behind the overall leader with nine stages remaining. 'My knee is really sore, but I'm happy with the result even if I lost a few seconds. I couldn't do better,' Contador admitted. 'I've been feeling the aftereffects of crashes in the first week, so my pedaling hasn't been great. Still, I believe I'll improve. Everyone is tired, and I hope this will play into my favor.' Voeckler, still leading by one minute and 49 seconds, saw Luxembourg's Frank Schleck move into second place after finishing third, 10 seconds behind Sanchez. Australia's Cadel Evans came in 30 seconds behind Sanchez in fifth, sitting third overall at 2:06 behind Voeckler. Andy Schleck finished sixth, 2:17 adrift overall, tied with Evans and Italy's Ivan Basso, who is fifth at 3:16 behind. Voeckler expressed relief at keeping pace with the stage leaders. 'I was a bit worried when I crashed near the top of the first climb. The road was slippery, so I changed my bike. On the final climb, I told myself to keep going, and Pierre Rolland helped me a lot. My legs felt good, and the Europcar team did an amazing job today.' Meanwhile, Mark Cavendish, Thursday's stage winner, finished more than 30 minutes behind in 153rd place but kept his green sprinter's jersey, extending his lead over Spain's Jose Joaquin Rojas. Sanchez also took the polka-dot jersey as King of the Mountains, while the Schleck brothers' Leopard-Trek team leads the teams' classification. Friday's 13th stage covers 152.5 kilometers from Pau to Lourdes, featuring a steep climb over the 1,709-meter Col d'Aubisque.
translated_content: Samuel Sanchez sampun kasub suminahang karanganing pangawit ring Tour de France puniki saniscaya Rahina Wraspati, nanging sajeroning mangda Alberto Contador, sasamang pesepeda Spanyol, kaseretang prestasinipun siap mangda karenan lomba melego ring bukit. Sanchez, sane dados rangking kalih ring Tour tawar tahun sane lampah, mulih mabur ring etap ka-12 saking Cugnaux ka Luz Ardiden, wenten langkung saking limang menit kasub pemimpin lomba, Thomas Voeckler. Nangging, juara balap sepeda Olimpiade 2008 puniki maju pesat saking grup pelolos ring tanjakan pungkasan bareng Jelle Vanendert. Pesepeda yowana umur 33 warse puniki ngelempasin Vanendert kalawan selisih pitu detik, megah ring Pyrenees. Kasampingin dasa warsa sampun lintang saking pamargin tim Euskaltel tur sane mawinan menang etap ring Luz Ardiden. Sambil mawantu, Sanchez nguningayang, 'Punika dinten penting. Titian ring klasemen umum titiang sampun tusing ngarih tiange dadi ancen. Titiang madagingang kesempatan punika. Titiang ningeh neng Andy Schleck lan Alberto Contador sampun kawatesan tetulung, maka idupun tusing kasidang ngiket pelarian titiang.' Sanchez mawinan sekadi 50 detik ajak Voeckler, sane kasub nyimpen kaos kuning sang sampun dadi rangking siwa. Contador, juara bertahan sane nguber gelar kaempat, ngeles rangking ka-8. Tiosan malih ipun sampun patpat menit kaanggen saking kapuput bersisa 9 etap malih. 'Titiang ngraos buduh ring jangkep, nanging titiang tetap gumine mangda pasrah ring hasil walaupun melepon sawat majalan. Titiang nenten nentenan ngicen maningech,' Contador malu. 'Kecelakaan ring minggu kapertama nyebabang sirikan ring gawak, nanging titiang satindan caya monggo bakat titiang bisa wiadin. Ragane pada kroda, titiang nguratang punika dados untung titiang.' Voeckler, sane nincapang pimpinan 1 menit 49 detik, ngraosang Frank Schleck saking Luxembourg munggah ka undag kalih sasampun dadi tigang, 10 detik daweg saking Sanchez. Australia's Cadel Evans misip 30 detik saking Sanchez ring rangking kalima, ijalanan rangking tiga umum 2:06 saking Voeckler. Andy Schleck matunggal kalawan selisih 2:17, kapebing kalawan Evans lan Ivan Basso saking Italia, rangking kalima kalawan selisih 3:16. Voeckler mangda mesolah bagia lantaran prasida nuutin sekaa barisan penabuh menek bukit. 'Titiang semengan gelis pas titiang ngasep ring pucuk tanjakan kapertama. Lajalan licin, titiang mulihang sepeda. Ring tanjakan pungkasan, titiang cingakin awak titiang mangda terus, lan Pierre Rolland ngulurin tangan ka titiang. Gawak titiang sehat, tim Europcar melempas upaya ageng ring dinten puniki.' Sajalan punika, Mark Cavendish, juara etap Rahina Wraspati, malali leuwih saking 30 menit ring posisi 153, nanging tetep ngacap kaos hijau (sprinter) lan mawinan mangda mepes utawi nyenatang keunggulan ipun saking pesepeda Spanyol Jose Joaquin Rojas. Sanchez nggih kasub makemit kaos totol (polka-dot) dados Raja Pegunungan, ritatkala tim Leopard-Trek tim kebo Andy Schleck lan jokane ngrebut pimpinan klasemen tim. Etap ka-13 ring Rahina Sukra mangda ngalantur 152.5 kilometer saking Pau ka Lourdes, maserang tanjakan tusing tegeh 1,709 meter ring Col d'Aubisque.
